queries.query: "large language model" OR LLM AND (network OR NetOps OR "network operations") AND (hallucinat* OR error OR incorrect OR unsafe OR failure)
queries.rationale: Capture literature documenting failure modes (hallucination, incorrect outputs) of LLMs when applied to network-operations tasks.

queries.query: "intent to configuration" OR "intent-to-configuration" OR "natural language" AND (configuration OR "network config" OR NETCONF) AND (translation OR synthesis OR "intent translation")
queries.rationale: Find work on translating human/intent descriptions into network configurations or policy artifacts.

queries.query: "LLM" OR "large language model" AND ("network configuration" OR "router config" OR "firewall rule")
queries.rationale: Identify papers and demos where LLMs directly generate or modify network configurations and related evaluation.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate validate repair" OR "generate-validate" AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "language model") AND (configuration OR NetOps OR network)
queries.rationale: Locate architectures that pair generation with verification and iterative repair for configuration tasks.

queries.query: (Batfish OR "network verification" OR VeriFlow OR Anteater OR "formal verification" AND network) OR ("reachability verification" "network configuration")
queries.rationale: Survey deterministic/formal network verification tools and techniques used as validators or oracles for NetOps outputs.

queries.query: "tool-assisted" OR "tool chain" OR "LLM + tool" OR "tool use" AND (NetOps OR network OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Find work on combining LLMs with external tools (validators, simulators, CLIs) in operational workflows.

queries.query: "agentic" OR "autonomous agent" OR "agent framework" AND (network OR NetOps OR AIOps)
queries.rationale: Locate research on agentic automation frameworks applied to NetOps and associated safety/trust concerns.

queries.query: "prompt engineering" AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration") AND (sensitivity OR robustness OR "prompt sensitivity")
queries.rationale: Locate studies on prompt dependence and sensitivity when prompting LLMs for operational tasks.

queries.query: ("adversarial" OR "red team" OR "attack" OR "misleading prompt") AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Find adversarial evaluation and red-team studies that stress-test LLM-generated operational outputs.

queries.query: "AIOps" OR "AIOps benchmark" OR "OpsEval" OR "NetOps benchmark" AND (evaluation OR dataset OR realism OR "external validity")
queries.rationale: Survey existing AIOps / NetOps benchmarks and studies discussing their validity and realism for operational evaluation.

queries.query: "Mininet" OR "emulator" OR "network simulator" AND (evaluation OR dataset OR benchmark) AND (LLM OR "language model" OR automation)
queries.rationale: Find works that use network emulators/simulators (Mininet, ns-3) to evaluate automated NetOps interventions or synthetic tasks.

queries.query: "functional correctness" OR "semantic correctness" AND (configuration OR NetOps OR "network change") AND (measurement OR metric OR evaluation)
queries.rationale: Locate metrics and operational definitions used to judge correctness of generated configs/changes (reachability, policy compliance, no downtime).

queries.query: "bounded self-correction" OR "bounded" OR "constraint" AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR configuration OR safety)
queries.rationale: Search for constrained or bounded generation approaches and provable/empirical bounds applied to operational LLM outputs.

queries.query: "human-in-the-loop" AND (NetOps OR network OR configuration) AND (review OR verification OR "change approval")
queries.rationale: Collect literature on human review/approval workflows combined with automated generation in operational settings.

queries.query: "configuration repair" OR "intent repair" OR "configuration synthesis" AND (LLM OR synthesis OR program synthesis) AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Identify work on automated repair or synthesis of network configs, including traditional program-synthesis and recent LLM approaches.

queries.query: "evaluation gap" OR "benchmark gap" OR "external validity" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (operations OR NetOps OR deployment)
queries.rationale: Find methodological critiques about how standard LLM/AI benchmarks fail to capture operational risk and reliability.

queries.query: "explainability" OR "interpretability" AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Survey explainability methods applied to LLM outputs in operational domains to support trust and debugging.

queries.query: "LLM evaluation" AND (safety OR robustness OR "operational" OR "real-world") AND (guidelines OR methodology OR framework)
queries.rationale: Locate evaluation frameworks, guidelines, and best practices for assessing LLMs in real-world or safety-critical contexts.

queries.query: "network change" OR "change management" AND (automation OR "automated change" OR "autonomous change") AND (risk OR rollback OR safety)
queries.rationale: Collect literature on automated change management in networks, including rollback, staging, and safety mechanisms.

queries.query: "related work" ("LLM for AIOps" OR "LLM for NetOps" OR "LLM network") AFTER:2018 BEFORE:2026
queries.rationale: Catch recent survey papers and related-work summaries in the target timeframe to map the field and find synthesis sources.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal papers, arXiv preprints, and technical reports relevant to LLMs and network operations.
Tool/project documentation and reproducible GitHub repositories for validators, emulators, and benchmark suites.
Works that present empirical evaluation, methodology, or clearly articulated threat/mitigation strategies for operational automation.
Public datasets, benchmark descriptions, and evaluation protocols for NetOps/AIOps tasks.
English-language sources with verifiable bibliographic metadata (title, authors, year, venue, DOI/arXiv ID).
exclusion_criteria: Marketing materials, product one-pagers, or non-technical blog posts lacking empirical/methodological content.
Works solely about general NLP benchmarks without connection to operational or NetOps use-cases.
Non-public or proprietary datasets/tools that cannot be inspected or reproduced.
Papers outside the scope of operational network correctness/safety (purely user-chatbot or creative-writing LLM studies).
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from ~2016–2026 to capture foundational ML/LLM advances and the rapid recent surge (2022–2026) in LLM-for-systems work; include earlier seminal network-verification or change-management works (pre-2016) when they are commonly cited or foundational (e.g., Batfish-era tools). Ensure coverage up to the current cutoff (mid/late 2026) for the freshest agentic/LLM-NetOps work.
